name: ogbg_molpcba_centered_gin_exact_reference_tail
notes: Reconstruction configuration; no original trained weights or unreleased pool IDs are claimed.
The generic exact-reference-tail backend performs full continuation checks and has different compute costs from the native arxiv tube backend.

The manuscript names a centered GIN-style molecular incumbent but does not provide its exact centering formula. This variant commits per-graph mean centering before message formation with an uncentered residual, five layers, width 128 and mean pooling. These settings and zeta=0.0016 nats are explicit reconstruction choices. Missing assays stay masked, and custom episodic/reserved results are distinct from full official-test AP.
Full: 512 calibration calls per configured depth per member, 512 selection calls per member, and 2048 final audit calls; smoke uses explicitly synthetic fixtures.
Variant centered_gin: the model family is manuscript-motivated; dimensions and omitted implementation details are explicit reconstruction choices.
